video_title: Chandler - Lakers are NOT a Championship Team! Luka Doncic Needs MVP Season!

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers are a championship-level offense but lack defensive championship pedigree
quotes.excerpt: I don't think they're a championship team. I think they're a championship offense.

text_blocks.speaker: Chandler Parsons
text_blocks.text: I don't think they're a championship team. I think they're a championship offense. I think Luka is always going to be in those MVP conversations just because the things he does offensively are still incredible. Defensively they're going to struggle and he's going to have to average 35 to 40 points a game, which he's more than capable of doing for them to even have a chance. Reeves is going to have to be good and Walker Kessler is going to have to continue to get 8 to 11 dunks a game at the rim.

text_blocks.speaker: Lou Williams
text_blocks.text: I'm with you on that one, Chandler. Last night was a small problem that they're going to run into that's going to turn into a big problem throughout this season if they have championship aspirations. They can't just hang their heads on going out and trying to outscore teams.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers' defensive struggles against dynamic guards will hinder championship success
quotes.excerpt: They're not known to be defensive-minded guys. That's going to stop this team from being successful.
quotes.quote: Last night was a small problem that they're going to run into that's going to turn into a big problem throughout this season if they have championship aspirations. They can't just hang their heads on going out and trying to outscore teams. When you look at the top three guys that are going to play the majority of these minutes, they're not known to be defensive-minded guys. That's going to stop this team from being successful, especially in that Western Conference when you got to deal with dynamic guards. They just ran into Ja Morant last night, you run into a Damian Lillard, and think about the other guards that's out there. The Devin Bookers of the world, the SGAs, and all of these guys. It's going to be tougher for them to try to get out of the Western Conference if they can't put a hold on some of these dynamic guards.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers' roster strategy relies on outscoring opponents through Luka and Austin Reaves
quotes.excerpt: I think their goal this season is just to outscore opponents, and I think they committed to that.
quotes.quote: I expected it to be this way. I think it was by design. I think their goal this season is just to outscore opponents, and I think they committed to that when they committed to their two lead guards in Luka and Austin Reaves. Let's be honest, these guys aren't defensive juggernauts in any way shape or form, but they're really, really great offensively, and I think that's what the Lakers are leaning their head on.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: JJ Redick must get creative with rotations to balance Lakers' defensive deficiencies
quotes.excerpt: JJ Redick is going to have to get real creative with going from man to zone.
quotes.quote: JJ Redick is going to have to get real creative with going from man to zone, to picking up 24 feet, to tweaking his rotations where you have Luka and Austin Reaves' minutes kind of offset with Colin Sexton and Thibodeau in there. He's going to have to get real creative because this team, again, just defensively, they're not good, and offensively they're really good, but there's got to be a balance. There's got to be some sort of rotation or some sort of scheme that he's going to have to come up with that's different to make sure this team is capable of getting stops.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic has a legitimate MVP chance in a wide-open Western Conference
quotes.excerpt: I think he has a chance at MVP this year if he can figure out a way.
quotes.quote: Looking at the injuries that have been happening, I think we're now in a situation where the West is kind of wide open. With that being said, I do think Luka, specifically this season, I think he has a chance at MVP this year if he can figure out a way to get the Lakers to a top four seed in the West. I think he has a legit chance. We know the numbers will support it. When it comes to this MVP and Luka, we got to stop talking about the defensive part of it because there's been plenty of MVPs that didn't play defense. We got one in Denver with three of them, and he's not the greatest defensive player. Steve Nash back-to-back. Regardless of all that, he has a chance at winning MVP and I think it's one of his best chances is this season because of how wide open the West has just become.
